name: North-East Region
eyebrow: North-East Region · Ang Mo Kio, Punggol and Sengkang
title: North-East Region:
title_em: new towns, waterways and Pulau Ubin.
tagline: Ang Mo Kio, Hougang, Punggol and Sengkang, with Seletar's aerospace park and the kampong island of Pulau Ubin.
summary: The North-East Region is a place of new towns and waterways. Ang Mo Kio is one of the oldest, while Punggol and Sengkang are newer, with waterfront housing and the Punggol Digital District taking shape.
Seletar is an aerospace hub, and offshore, Pulau Ubin keeps something of the old kampong, with its granite quarries and tracks that are fun to cycle.

community.intro: People from these new towns are often young families, and many Singaporeans abroad remember growing up in the older towns such as Ang Mo Kio.

ancestry: Tracing your family in Singapore? The National Archives of Singapore and the National Library Board hold oral histories, newspapers, maps and records, and many are searchable online.
